presentation: [Sweet Temptation] Brave Girl Anghalhad has a skill that deals greater damage the higher her Pierce Rate.

passif.description:
For [FFAE00]each[-] [00D5FF]Applicable Ally[-] participating in battle, their basic stats increase by [FFAE00]6%[-] and Pierce Rate increases by [FFAE00]40%[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Applicable Ally: Self, [Four Knights of the Apocalypse][/i][-]

[00D5FF]Increases the hero's skill ranks[-] at the start of the battle. (Limit [FFAE00]once[-])

Inflicts [00D5FF]Dazzle[-] on [00D5FF]Human enemies[-] for [FFAE00]2 turns[-] at the start of the battle if all allies participating in battle other than the hero are [00D5FF][Four Knights of the Apocalypse] heroes[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Dazzle: All stats [FFAE00]-10%[-], Defense [FFAE00]-30%[-].[/i][-]

The hero's damage taken does not exceed [FFAE00]60%[-] of Max HP from skills used by [00D5FF]Dazzled[-] enemies during their turn.

Increases Attack by [FFAE00]80%[-] when an [00D5FF]Applicable Ally[-] uses skills on [00D5FF]Dazzled[-] enemies.

When the hero uses an [00D5FF]all-target attack[-] on a [00D5FF]Dazzled[-] enemy in [00D5FF]PVP[-], they are rendered [00D5FF]Defenseless[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Defenseless: Attacks after removing Barrier Buff.[/i][-]
